description: This file defines the ReflectionCallable class within the Twig\'s Util namespace, used for reflection and callable introspection of Twig callables.

classes.name: ReflectionCallable
classes.description: A utility class for reflecting on callables in Twig, providing methods to retrieve the reflector, the callable, and the callable's name.

methods.name: getReflector
methods.description: Returns the ReflectionMethod or ReflectionFunction object associated with the callable.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the callable in its original form.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name or description of the callable.
